messages:
amanda: Stellarsail just returned the RFP. TL;DR — they need: private deployment (VPC), FIPS/HSM keywrap, burst to 200 rps for embeddings+gen, 95th-pctl latency <180ms for text-gen, and the signed security questionnaire + capability matrix. Who owns the attachments and quick POC plan?

raj: Do we have clarity on POC scope? Are they asking for a full end-to-end demo with their dataset or just connectivity + perf numbers? Also, region preference?

amanda: They want an E2E POC with synthetic data first, then a short run on a redacted subset. Prefer AWS eu-west-1. POC duration requested = 3 weeks.

claire: I can assemble the capability matrix + sec pack. Quick pricing sketch (ballpark) for the POC + 1mo Dedicated reserve:```
POC (3w): $18k flat
Dedicated reserve (1mo, small): $25k
Burst add-on (200 rps): $6k/mo
Private deployment setup + HSM onboarding: one-time $12k
```

claire: I'll upload the capability matrix + SOC2/HIPAA scoping doc to the shared drive and link it in the RFP packet.

sean: Heads up — HSM onboarding calendar is blocked ~4–6 weeks for our compliance team. If they need FIPS envelope earlier we can propose KMS-integration as a short-term mitigation (we'll need POA and NDA updates).

saleh: Proposed POC runbook (high level):
1) Week 0: kickoff, network peering + IP allowlist, provide test creds.
2) Week 1: baseline perf (synthetic), run 50 concurrent streams, capture 95/99 pctls.
3) Week 2: redacted dataset run, validate outputs and drift checks.
4) Week 3: optimizations (quantization profile, batching), handoff + exec demo.

saleh: Responsible owners: sales (amanda) lead comms, eng-ml (saleh) runbench, eng-platform (sean) handle infra + HSM, security (claire) provide sec pack.

raj: For the security questionnaire, any known gaps? Claire, anything we should pre-fill before sending?

claire: A couple items flagged: no FedRAMP attestation, HSM timeline (see sean), and we need signed DPA language for EU data residency. I'll prefill everything else and mark 'timeline-dependent' on HSM/FedRAMP.

amanda: Sounds good. Can someone assemble the single ZIP with: capability matrix (xlsx), signed sec questionnaire (pdf), SOC2 summary (pdf), POC runbook (md), and pricing sheet (csv)? I can attach to the RFP portal.

claire: I'll drop the zip to the drive and post link here in ~2h.

deploy-bot: File uploaded: s3://redwood-rfps/stellarsail/stellarsail_rfp_packet_v1.zip (owner: claire)

amanda: Perfect. One last ask — sales exec wants a short slide (1 slide) summarizing risks + mitigations for the customer execs. Can someone draft?

sean: I'll draft the slide: highlight HSM timeline, fallback KMS option, expected latency SLOs, and proposed Dedicated+Private hybrid.

amanda: Thanks all. I'll post final bundle to the portal and ping legal for DPA signature path. :thumbsup:
